ascvd_risk.long_name: Mean 10-year risk of heart attack and stroke (ASCVD) for people aged 40-70
ascvd_risk.short_description: Mean 10-year ASCVD risk score (percent) among Veradigm patients in this area.
ascvd_risk.long_description: Mean 10-year Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) risk score, in percent, among Veradigm EHR patients with all data elements needed to calculate the score. Reported by 3-digit ZIP (ZCTA3) and nationally, overall and by age group (40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+), race, and sex. Stratum rows with no observations are omitted. The source stores the value as a proportion; it is multiplied by 100 here. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 08/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-08-31).
ascvd_risk.statement: In {location}, the mean 10-year ASCVD risk was {value}%.

ascvd_n.long_name: Number of patients contributing to the mean ASCVD risk
ascvd_n.short_description: Number of patients whose risk score contributes to the mean in this row.
ascvd_n.long_description: Number of Veradigm patients (observations) behind the mean 10-year ASCVD risk in the same row. Provided for context on precision; small counts mean less stable means. Time period represented: 01/01/2022 – 08/31/2025. The `time` value in the standard data is the last date of this period (2025-08-31).
ascvd_n.statement: In {location}, the mean ASCVD risk was based on {value} patients.

veradigm.name: 10-year ASCVD risk
veradigm.description: Data for the 10-year Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease (ASCVD) risk score are provided by Veradigm from multiple sources using the Veradigm Network Electronic Health Record (EHR) database for patients with all data elements necessary for score calculation. These data cover the period 01/01/2022-08/31/2025. It is important to note that the data displayed are not intended to represent the entire US population.
veradigm.restrictions: Data can be reused with attribution of data from Veradigm, obtained via the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).
